# Briefing Preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Daily brief:** short, morning, plain-language. Lead with anything donor- or board-facing, then
  program items, then internal. Call out overdue commitments explicitly.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Weekly preview (Mondays):** the week's donor meetings, funder deadlines, board/committee dates,
  and program milestones. Flag any grant deadline or LOI due.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Weekly retro (Fridays):** what moved on fundraising and programs; what slipped; who to thank.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Always surface:** funding-status changes (a grant declined, a major gift confirmed) the moment
  they land — these change Cam's whole week.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Never surface:** the [Willow](../projects/willow.md) real subject or donor in any routine brief;
  reference it by code name only.
